description: This file defines UI design tokens, components, and styles that match an Android reference design, implemented in SwiftUI. It includes color constants, view styles, and custom button and view components to ensure consistent theming across the app.

classes.name: AndroidRefCard
classes.description: A reusable card container with a background, border, and corner radius matching Android design guidelines.

classes.name: AndroidRefTextFieldStyle
classes.description: Custom text field style with padding, background fill, and border matching the Android theme.

classes.name: AndroidRefPrimaryButtonStyle
classes.description: Button style for a primary colored button with configurable disabled state and pressed opacity.

classes.name: AndroidRefChipButtonStyle
classes.description: Small chip-style button with background fill and border, used for secondary actions.

methods.name: body (in AndroidRefCard)
methods.description: Defines the view hierarchy and styling for the card container.

methods.name: _body (in AndroidRefTextFieldStyle)
methods.description: Defines the styling for text fields using the custom style.

methods.name: makeBody (in AndroidRefPrimaryButtonStyle)
methods.description: Creates a styled button with background color, padding, and shape for primary actions.

methods.name: makeBody (in AndroidRefChipButtonStyle)
methods.description: Creates a styled chip button with background fill, border, and rounded corners.

methods.name: androidRefScreenPadding (in extension View)
methods.description: Applies horizontal padding as per the Android theme's outer horizontal padding.
